title: Declared mixed date formats
brief: Parse declared date formats and expose rejected input.
instructions: Accept trimmed YYYY-MM-DD, US MM/DD/YYYY, and DD Mon YYYY in that order. Missing input is missing; failed parsing is invalid with original rejected text; successful parsing is valid. Reject DD/MM/YYYY and impossible dates.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes contact_id,date_text from raw_contacts without solving declared mixed date formats.

hints.text: Use explicit format guards and non-throwing date parsers.
Try the three declared formats in order, preserve the original text, and derive parse state separately.
02/03/2024 means February 3; 31/12/2024 and February 30 are invalid.
